headline: Fewer, sharper alerts across all the sites is something I'd use, but the promise says nothing about telling me which listings are fake or misleading before I waste a trip, and the calm, at-your-own-pace tone doesn't fit a market where speed wins.
must_fix: Promise something about noise and misleading listings, not just matching. Even if you avoid the word 'verified', say JIMS flags likely AI or staged photos, mismatched room counts or already-rented units, so an alert tells me whether a place is worth one of my tour slots.

Make it clear JIMS never makes me slower than the next applicant: alerts as fast as or faster than StreetEasy, and a one-tap way to contact the lister or request a tour. Right now the 'calm, at your pace' framing reads like I'll find out second.
Say it replaces my tracking with a shortlist or status view of what I've seen, contacted and toured. Otherwise it's one more app sending me notifications on top of the spreadsheet.
would_flip_me: Add one line to the positioning saying each alert includes a quick worth-touring read (photo or room-count red flags, already-rented signals) and saves to a shortlist that replaces manual tracking.
in_character_reaction: Ok, 'a clear match, not another tab' is literally what I want, and pulling from every site so I'm not refreshing five apps would save me hours. But the whole thing is about calm and going at my own pace, and that's not my problem. My problem is the place is gone in a day and half the photos are AI. If the alert can't tell me which of these is actually worth a train ride, it's just a nicer StreetEasy alert.
